blocks.text: Aam taur par immune system ke T aur B cells sirf bairooni molecules aur cells par hamla kar ke unhein maarte hain. Is ki wajah yeh hai ke har shakhs ke cells ki satah par self-proteins hote hain. Self-proteins ka har shakhs ka khaas set molecular “fingerprints” (pehchan ke nishan) jaisa hai jise us ke apne T aur B cells pehchante hain.

Identical twins (hamshakal judwan) ke self-proteins 100% milte hain. Sab se achha mel khandan ke andar hi milta hai. Transplant ke liye tarjeeh ki tarteeb yeh hai: identical twin > behan/bhai (sibling) > maa/baap (parent) > ghair rishtedaar (unrelated donor). Ghair rishtedaar donor ke recipient se milne ka imkaan 1,00,000 se 2,00,000 mein se 1 hai.
blocks.title: Donor ka mel

blocks.text: Jab kisi shakhs ko transplant ke zariye koi uzv (organ) lagaya jata hai to mumkin hai ke diye gaye uzv ke self-proteins lene wale (recipient) ke self-proteins se na milte hon. Nateeje mein recipient ke T cells lagaye gaye uzv ke cells par hamla kar sakte hain aur B cells us ke proteins ke khilaf antibodies bana sakte hain. Is masle ko transplant rejection kehte hain. Rejection kam karne ke liye doctor aisa donor dhoondte hain jis ke self-proteins recipient se jitna ho sake milte hon. Woh aisi dawaen bhi dete hain jo lagaye gaye uzv ke khilaf recipient ke immune system ko daba deti hain. Lekin yeh dawaen infections se larne ki salahiyat bhi kam kar deti hain.

Transplant rejection rokne ke do tareeqe hain. Aik tareeqe mein monoclonal antibodies se un T cells ko tabah kiya jata hai jo transplant par hamla karte hain. Doosre tareeqe mein stem cells se naya immune system banaya jata hai jo transplant ko apna (self) samajhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki numbering
blocks.text: Kitab ne 'Autoimmune Diseases' aur 'Transplant Rejection' dono ko '2-' number diya hai; Roman Urdu mein tarteeb ke mutabiq Transplant Rejection ko 3- likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Allergy ke teekon (desensitization) se allergy kyun kam hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: In se khoon mein G-antibodies banti hain jo allergen ko mast cells par lagi E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle hi khatam kar deti hain, is liye kam histamine nikalti hai.

items: Allergy: kamzor antigens ke liye hypersensitivity; E-antibodies mast cells se jurti hain, mast cells histamines chhorte hain; ilaaj antihistamines aur desensitization (G-antibodies).
Autoimmune: myasthenia gravis, SLE, rheumatoid arthritis, Type I diabetes.
Transplant rejection: self-proteins na milein to T cells aur B cells hamla karte hain; mel wala donor, immunity dabane wali dawaen, monoclonal antibodies, stem cells.
